caseName: M. F. A. Central Cooperative v. Bookwalter
caseNameFull: M. F. A. Central Cooperative v. Bookwalter, District Director of Internal Revenue

opinions.text:
C. A. 8th Cir. Motion to expedite consideration of petition for writ of certiorari denied. Motion of petitioners to argue orally as amicus curiae in No. 1082 denied.

Mr. Justice Blackmun took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions.
